# Identifiers

Every identifier a platform document may cite, its single meaning, and the registry that resolves it. The checker rejects undeclared IDs and retired labels in controlled documents.

## Platform namespaces

| Prefix | Meaning | Resolves in | Allocation |
|---|---|---|---|
| R | Product requirement (normative, human language). | `registry/requirements.yaml` | Next integer, in the PR that adds the requirement. Never reused. |
| QA | Quality-attribute requirement, grouped by pillar. ACC is accuracy and A11Y is accessibility. | `registry/requirements.yaml` | Next two-digit number within the pillar. QA-A11Y-01 was the first, with PDR-0001. |
| T | Conformance test specification. Implemented in soul-conformance. | `registry/tests.yaml` | Next two-digit number. Never reused. |
| PDR | Platform decision record, a decision that binds more than one repository. | `docs/04-decisions/` | The number is the number of the decision's discussion in the Decisions category of true-line/agent-bot-platform. GitHub numbers issues, PRs and discussions from one sequence, so two agents can never mint the same number. |
| WP | Work package from whitepaper draft 0.4 section 13. | `registry/repos.yaml` | Closed set WP1 to WP7. A new package needs a PDR. |
| Stage | Delivery stage with exit evidence, whitepaper draft 0.4 section 13. | `registry/tests.yaml` | Closed set. |
| S | Source document (paper, plan, owner Q&A). | `registry/sources.yaml` | Next integer. S1 to S5 keep the numbering draft 0.4 gave them. |
| X | External standard or specification. | `registry/sources.yaml` | Next integer. Replaces the R1 to R8 reference labels in draft 0.4. |
| DRIFT | A recorded conflict between two sources of truth, open until resolved. | `docs/00-governance/drift-register.md` | Next three-digit number. |
| RISK | Program or product risk. | `docs/10-program/risk-register.md` | Next three-digit number. Never reused; a closed risk keeps its row. |

## Identifiers owned elsewhere

| Prefix | Owner | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| ENG | qwts/qwts-agent-sop | Org-wide engineering decision. Cite as ENG-NNNN (globally unique). |
| ADR | each component repository | Repository-local decision. Numbers repeat across repositories, so a platform doc must cite it qualified: "agent-bot-comms ADR-0028". |
| error code | true-line/soul-contracts errors/registry.json | snake_case error identifiers such as profile_insufficient. |

## Retired labels

| Label | Write instead | Why |
|---|---|---|
| R1-R8 (references in draft 0.4) | X1-X8 | Collided with requirements R1-R12 in the same paper. |
| D1-D4 (north star decisions) | S1 D1 to S1 D4 when quoting; the PDR that adopts it once accepted | agent-bot-hq reuses D1-D4 for different decisions. |
| A2-A4 (north star working assumptions) | S1 A2 to S1 A4 when quoting | Unqualified letters are ambiguous across documents. |
| D1-D4, Q1-Q8, R1-R10 (agent-bot-hq daemon-plugin-split) | agent-bot-hq D4 (qualified); risks move to RISK-NNN | Daemon risks R1-R10 collide with requirements R1-R12. |
